verdict.rationale: A community-quoted Ollama log ([ollama-comm-11]) shows that when GPU acceleration fails, Ollama emits a specific reason: 'amdgpu detected, but no compatible rocm library found... will use cpu: no suitable rocm found, falling back to CPU'. This is the product's own diagnostic output explaining the fallback. However, the only support is a single community snippet for one AMD/ROCm case. It is unclear whether the message reaches the user anywhere beyond the server logs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of GPU-detection and fallback diagnostics, evidence that the output covers NVIDIA, Apple, and other failure modes, evidence that the fallback is surfaced to the user rather than buried in logs, and hands-on corroboration across platforms.
